fusions.name: Bilge Spray
fusions.desc: A hand pump sprays a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wind-Up Decoy
fusions.desc: Sends a clockwork decoy forward. It deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Sealant Coat
fusions.desc: Sprays you with sealant. For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Pontoon Feet
fusions.desc: Floats under your feet let you walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 12% faster, from silver your mana recovers 20% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
